Computes the next SplitMix64 state and the corresponding random 64-bit value. The implementation matches the canonical SplitMix64 generator and is bit-identical to the Python reference in onnx_light.backend.random.

parameterdescription.para: Current 64-bit state.

detaileddescription.para: Generates deterministic uniform random values in [0, 1) shaped as shape. An empty shape produces a single value (count 1).

parameterdescription.para: Output shape; dimensions must be non-negative.
Optional 64-bit seed. std::nullopt selects the default seed (0).

simplesect.para: Flat row-major std::vector<double> of length prod(shape).

parameterdescription.para: when any dimension is negative.

memberdef.argsstring: (int64_t low, int64_t high, const std::vector< int64_t > &shape, std::optional< uint64_t > seed=std::nullopt)
memberdef.name: RandInt

detaileddescription.para: Generates deterministic pseudo-random integers in the half-open interval [low, high) using rejection sampling on the SplitMix64 output to obtain an unbiased distribution.

parameterdescription.para: Inclusive lower bound.
Exclusive upper bound. Must be strictly greater than low.
Output shape; dimensions must be non-negative.
Optional 64-bit seed. std::nullopt selects the default seed.

simplesect.para: Flat row-major std::vector<int64_t> of length prod(shape).

parameterdescription.para: when high <= low or any dimension is negative.

detaileddescription.para: Generates deterministic pseudo-random values with an approximate normal distribution using the Irwin-Hall approximation (sum of 12 uniform values minus 6).

parameterdescription.para: Output shape; dimensions must be non-negative.

detaileddescription.para: Generates a deterministic BOOL Tensor of the requested shape by drawing approximately-normal values from :cpp:func:Randn and thresholding at 0. Mirrors the upstream ONNX test pattern (np.random.randn(...) > 0).astype(bool) used by onnx.backend.test.case.node cases (e.g. And/Or/Xor).

parameterdescription.para: Output tensor shape; dimensions must be non-negative.
Optional 64-bit seed. std::nullopt selects the default seed.

simplesect.para: A Tensor with data_type == BOOL whose data is a flat row-major buffer of one byte per element (0 or 1).

parameterdescription.para: when any dimension is negative.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the size in bytes of one element of dtype (a TensorProto::DataType integer). Throws std::invalid_argument for unsupported types.

detaileddescription.para: Builds a single-node ModelProto from node and the provided typed inputs/outputs, then appends a TestCase to registry.
Mirrors onnx_light.backend.test.case.base.expect(). Only the inputs and outputs whose name is non-empty in the node are wired into the graph.

parameterdescription.para: Single-node template; its op_type, domain and attributes are kept.
Concrete input tensors corresponding to the non-empty entries of node.input.
Concrete expected output tensors corresponding to the non-empty entries of node.output.
Unique test name (used both for TestCase.name and the graph name).
Opset imports for the generated model. If empty the caller is responsible for ensuring a default has been applied — typically pass at least DefaultOpset(since_version).
Producer name written into the model.
Output registry (appended to).
